svg.aria-label: Working back from the ship window. A calendar strip runs left to right: Assessment works back from the date, Mobilization can begin rapidly once approved, then the crew is on the line and its coverage builds until it is at full strength for the window: a retail reset, a promotion, a co-packing commitment or a seasonal window.
